l1.text: Welcome to NeuroPro, brought to you with our partners at MoveDocs. Here's how we care for your injured clients.

l2.text: NeuroPro is a national concussion clinic, providing concussion care, neuropsychological testing, and mental health care. Our team has seen more than a hundred fifty thousand head injuries, we're licensed in forty-six states, and most clients are seen within seven to ten days.

l3.text: NeuroPro was founded more than fifteen years ago by Doctor Anthony Doran, a neuropsychologist with a twenty-year Navy career. He completed a fellowship at Harvard, taught at the Naval Academy and Johns Hopkins, and helped pass Maryland's concussion law. What started as one doctor is now close to thirty clinicians, caring for clients across the country.

l4.text: You don't need to diagnose anything. You only need to recognize when something isn't right: a head injury, anxiety or poor sleep after a crash, or a client who needs testing. Send the referral, and our clinicians determine the right evaluation.

l5.text: One referral puts your client into one coordinated network: a concussion evaluation, neuropsychological testing, mental health treatment, and medico-legal support, with one team from intake through trial.

l6.text: A clean scan doesn't mean a healthy brain. Most concussions don't show up on a CT or MRI. A neurologist checks whether the brain is damaged. NeuroPro measures what that damage does to your client's life.

l7.text: Be careful with a DTI. It's discoverable, and if it comes back normal, the defense calls it no damage. Lead with a NeuroPro evaluation, and add imaging only if it helps.

l8.text: A few questions we hear often. The accident was a while ago? It's not too late. The defense says your client is faking? Our testing has built-in effort checks. And who pays? Injury cases can be handled on a lien through MoveDocs.

l9.text: Referring a client is simple: spot the need, send the referral directly to NeuroPro, and we take it from there. Your MoveDocs representative is always there to help. When a client has a head injury, or anything affecting their mental health, think NeuroPro.

l10.text: Thank you for trusting us with your care.
